messages:
cheng: Ran overnight int6 sweep on ultraembed v1.2 vs fp16 baseline. Longtail holdout recall@10 -3.2% abs. Cluster purity +0.6, silhouette unchanged. Uploading artifacts.

(eval-bot): artifact created s3://redwood-evals/ultraembed/1776543210/artifact.tar.gz

rachel: Oof. Can you split by cohort (short/long queries)?

cheng: short queries (len<=16): recall@10 -0.6%; mid (17-64): -1.5%; long (>64): -6.1%.

ajay: Huge drop in long. Did you try per-channel quantization (pcq) vs scalar? Also any whitening/mean-subtraction applied?

cheng: PCQ run included; this int6 was global. No whitening in this run. I'll kick PCQ next. Command used:
```
python eval.py --model ultraembed-int6 --dataset longtail --metrics recall@10,recall@1,silhouette --quant global
```

maria: Can you dump L2 norms histogram? Often int ops compress norm tail. Quick snippet:
```
np.histogram(np.linalg.norm(embs,axis=1), bins=100)
```

sam: Also check index params: ef_search and hnsw_m. If vector space contracts, topk order changes. What were index settings?

cheng: Using HNSW m=32 ef_search=128 for both runs. Same index seed. Norm dist shift looks real: mean L2 0.42 -> 0.34 on int6.

rachel: Could be quant scale clipping. Save calibration scales and per-channel maxes.

cheng: Will run PCQ + whitening + save calibration stats. Plan: 1) run pcq int6 (per-channel scales), 2) run int6+whitening, 3) produce per-cohort recall breakdown + norms + topk-change heatmap.

ajay: Add failure-case examples (queries where ground truth moves out of top10). Those help root cause.

maria: +1. Also log nearest-neighbor distances before/after for those failing queries.

cheng: noted. Re-running now on a 4-shard job. ETA ~3h. I'll post artifacts when done. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

rachel: thx. If drop persists after PCQ+whitening, consider 8-bit float or fallback policy for long queries. :thinking_face:

(eval-bot): test-run queued job id=jr-1776543210-1 status=running

sam: :thumbsup:

cheng: action items: cheng->run pcq+whitening + save stats; rachel->prep A/B on dedicated if needed; ajay->script to diff NN orders; maria->prepare norm plots. will update.
